TEMPURA SERVED COLD
Jan 2025 • Solo
Waited almost half an hour and was served only a cup of hot tea despite having ordered a Bento Salmon Tempura set and Baked oysters. Had I not asked for Ming Huyen who took my order and then I had to ask her again after having waited forso long. Apparently the food was left at the counter with no one bothering to check and serve. When it was finally brought to me the food was cold. I told the pregnant staff Trinh to touch the food with her hand and she herself acknowledged that the food was cold. Then the manager finally came over and she also acknowledged the same thing. Issue was that the restaurant was not full hence there should be no excuse. This seems to be trendy in all their restaurants here in HCMC. This time in Saigon Square. What is the point of having so many staff and categorized them as servers and order takers if they are unable to do their job. Didn't even bother to change so I asked for the bill. As I only had a tea while waiting they didn't charge me hence I left.

Okay
Nov 2024 • Couples
As an avid sushi lover who has had multiple sushi places in Vietnam, this restaurant is overrated and is too expensive for its quality.

Food: We got quite a few dishes when we came here: sashimis including salmon belly and sea urchin, salmon mentaiko and salmon ikura nigiris, cheese and ebi rolls, crab shell, raw oysters, stir fried udon and 2 grilled fish. Overall, the food was either bad or not impressive. We paid around $100, which doesn’t sound bad but for Vietnam, it is quite expensive.

The sashimi was not fresh. The salmon belly sashimi did not have that soft melting effect and its texture was like jelly-like. The sea urchin also was not fresh and did not have a nice taste to it. Oysters were quite fishy and also not fresh. The grilled fish along with udon lacked flavors. Other foods were fine i guess, but not amazing or good compared to other places in PXL.

Service was okay, but they wanted me to sign a receipt for hoá đơn đỏ, which was weird so I didn’t sign it. However, they were being pretty pushy about it.

Atmosphere is fine.

I just think this place is super overrated. It’s not absolutely terrible but you can get better sushi at a cheaper cost in PXL like Haru Sushi or Tokyo Deli or Cobeya.
